title: atlas.entity.create.v1 — arguments
description: An `other`-typed entity is not creatable here: `other` is an output-side reserved member, and a type introduced later reaches a consumer as `other` plus a label rather than as a token it can request. Create those through a maintenance path.

also_known_as.description: Nicknames, not id aliases: an alias is a row in the id ledger, a nickname is an observation the registry holds. Optional; defaults to none.
